what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as site engineer. Home had a Record expense button, which opened a Site expense form (Project preset to Kapoor Villa (Audit), What was it for, Paid through, date, Vendor, receipt, Amount). I entered a description, vendor 'No vendor', who was paid 'Contractor' and amount 12000. On Send for approval, the app refused with a toast: 'Site expenses are for small amounts, up to ₹5,000 each. Ask accounts to enter larger ones. Check the details and try again.' Nothing was saved or sent; the form stayed open. The 12,000 cash contractor payment cannot be recorded by this role.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: none; Record expense on Home was obvious
unnecessary_steps: Vendor must be actively chosen even though none is listed (had to pick No vendor)
Had to invent a payee name 'Contractor' because Who was paid? is required and the brief gave none
confusing_terminology: Paid through -> only option is 'I paid for this myself', no cash or company option
Send for approval -> unclear for a payment already made in cash
Choose a project vendor -> list empty, only Suggest a new vendor / No vendor
missing_feedback: No inline error on Amount field, only a toast far from the field
Typing 12000 above the 5,000 limit gave no warning until submit; only shows rupee formatting below
No path offered in-app to ask accounts or escalate
unexpected_behaviour: Choosing 'No vendor' with the mouse did not register; it only worked via keyboard
Selecting No vendor adds a new required field 'Who was paid?' that shifts the layout
Amount field is at the very bottom, below the fold, needs scrolling in the dialog
errors_encountered: Please select an item in the list.
Site expenses are for small amounts, up to ₹5,000 each. Ask accounts to enter larger ones. Check the details and try again.
visual_issues: Error toast is dark red/maroon with small light text, bottom-right, easy to miss and low contrast
Amount field and helper text partly clipped at the bottom of the scrolling dialog
Dialog field spacing inconsistent between labels and inputs
accessibility_issues: Native browser validation bubbles only; error toast appears away from focus and may not be announced
Custom select dropdown mouse selection unreliable
observations: The limit is stated in the Amount label ('up to 5,000') and the toast message is clear about the reason and who to ask, which is good. But the user only learns after filling the whole form, with no way to message accounts from the screen. Task could not be completed by this role, which appears to be by design.

rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: Needed to fill vendor, payee, scroll, and submit before learning the amount exceeded the limit; no escalation route.
rating_justifications.error_prevention: Limit shown only in a small label; typing 12000 gave no inline warning and the submit button stayed enabled.
rating_justifications.error_recovery: Toast said ask accounts but offered no link, contact or way to save the entry; 'Check the details and try again' is misleading since retry cannot work.
rating_justifications.accessibility: Mouse selection in the vendor dropdown failed; errors are a transient toast and native bubbles far from the field.
